text:
maria: found a mismatch in migration guide: v2 error payload now uses { error: { type, message, param } } but guide still shows flat message. We need a quick update and snippets. cc @kevin @samantha
kevin: saw this too when migrating embeddings. Which files?
maria: docs/migration/errors.md and examples/error-handling/js.md
samantha: I can update the guide. Proposal: show v2 native shape + a tiny compatibility shim for users during rollout.
tim: also add note about retry semantics: v2 uses Retry-After (seconds) for 429s; recommend jittered exponential backoff.
kevin: will open PR to update SDK examples with a small normalize helper and unit test. draft PR in examples repo shortly.
maria: @docs-bot add a deprecation banner task and set target to ship docs updates by Thu EOD.
docs-bot: Created docs-card #701 and set reminder Thu 18:00 UTC.
samantha: snippet for docs: ```js
try{ await client.generate(...) }catch(err){ const body=err?.response?.data||err; const msg=body?.error?.message||body?.message||String(err); const code=body?.error?.type||body?.code||'unknown'; console.error({code,msg}) }
```
kevin: LGTM, mirroring into TS examples and adding test. I'll note hosted API keeps a thin v1 shim for 14 days after docs change.
maria: add checklist item: errors + retry-after header + model-alias naming. reviewers: @kevin @tim please review by EOD Wed.
samantha: will ping when CI green. :pray:
